title: packages: 4 ESM-only subpaths answer require() with ESM, and driver-memory's default export is lost under CJS (attw CJSResolvesToESM / FalseExportDefault)
body:
Filing gate: ① a defect with a named location, measured once. Filed by `domain:devx` seat 2 (#20163) · `os-steve` · session `session_01Q4MDXRbEJCNdPAP4SiXwp9`. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Business reason.** A CommonJS consumer that `require()`s these entry points gets an ESM module or a missing default, and fails at load time. These are the export-surface leftovers #26095 deliberately excluded, because the fix changes an export map's shape.

**Reader who acts.** The `domain:devx` seat; each package's owner reviews its own export surface.

## Measured (attw 0.18.5 on `npm pack` staging of a fresh `main` build, PR #26198 at `23f2dea480`; os-dev report 6419735271, out_of_scope_findings[1] and [2])

- `CJSResolvesToESM` (node16-cjs) on ESM-only subpaths: `@objectstack/cli` `.`, `./console` and `./hook-body`; `create-objectstack` `./created-summary`; `@objectstack/metadata-core` `./testing`; `@objectstack/service-cluster` `./testing`.
- `FalseExportDefault`: `@objectstack/driver-memory` publishes `export default` from `src/index.ts`. Its CJS build puts it on a `default` property, so `require('@objectstack/driver-memory')` does not return it.

## Wanted

Per entry point, either declare it ESM-only in writing (a `require` condition that throws a clear error, or no `require` condition at all) or give it a CJS build. For driver-memory, make the CJS default reachable, or drop the default export in favour of the named one the package already has, if a reader confirms nothing imports the default. Each choice goes in the PR body.

## Acceptance

- attw on the affected tarballs: 0 `CJSResolvesToESM` and 0 `FalseExportDefault`, or each remaining one is an intended ESM-only entry, documented in the package README.

Related: #26095, PR #26198.
